name: solution-scope
description: Work on a slice of a large .NET solution. Generate .slnf solution filters, switch between them, and scope the C# language server to the one you need.

solutionScope.configuration.description: MSBuild configuration used to resolve conditional ProjectReference entries. Set this when your projects wire dependencies differently per configuration.

solutionScope.includeTestProjects.description: When generating a filter, also include projects that reference the selection and look like test projects.

solutionScope.restartLanguageServerOnSwi.description: Run the C# extension's 'Restart .NET Language Server' command after switching scope.

solutionScope.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current scope in the status bar.

solutionScope.exclude.description: Glob pattern excluded when discovering solution and filter files.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test --label integration
scripts.test:integration:csharp: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test --label csharp
scripts.test:integration:multiroot: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test --label multi-root
scripts.test:integration:all: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test
